name: Kor
description: The kor are a mostly nomadic, white-aligned humanoid people native to Zendikar, with white, gray or blue skin and hair, who once built an empire and its Skyclaves.

bio.text: On Zendikar the kor travel nomadically hunting mikunga on the winds, and some of them were drawn onto Rath, where Volrath and later a new evincar made them a slave race.

citations.text: "The Master at Arms". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Sep 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.
"Kor", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Their Zendikari empire collapsed to rebellions, civil wars and the Eldrazi, and the Skyclaves fell in different ways, among them to the Kargan dragon-riders and to a civil war between Makindi and the Ondu Skyclave.

timeline.summary: Volrath draws the Kor into Rath along with other peoples.
timeline.quote: The Kor were drawn into Rath by Volrath like other peoples

citation.text: "Kor", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The reclusive Kor unite because of the need to destroy Volrath.
timeline.quote: Only a matter as vital as destroying Volrath could bring together the reclusive Kor people.

citation.text: Warrior en-Kor (World Championship Decks 1998, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Rath's new evincar eliminates the moggs and takes the Kor as a new slave race.
timeline.quote: Rath's new evincar eliminated the brutish moggs and took a new slave race

citation.text: Kor Dirge (Planar Chaos, 2007), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The kor travel nomadically across Zendikar hunting mikunga on the Roil-churned winds, connecting to their surroundings with lines and hooks.
timeline.quote: The kor follow a nomadic lifestyle, chasing the winds across Zendikar, hunting the mikunga

citation.text: "The Master at Arms". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Sep 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: As the Makindi Empire crumbled, the Kargan tribes mastered Akoum's dragons and rode them to victory over the kor, shattering the Akoum Skyclave.
timeline.quote: the Kargan tribes mastered the dragons of Akoum and rode them to victory against the kor

citation.text: "Akoum", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the Eldrazi's return, kor gather around Glasspool and carve dwellings in the surrounding peaks.
timeline.quote: During the eldrazi's return, kor gathered in the area around Glasspool

citation.text: "Akoum", section "Notable locations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The ancient kor empire of Zendikar falls one by one to rebellions, civil wars and the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: One by one they fell to rebellions, civil wars, and eventually the Eldrazi.

citation.text: "Kor", section "Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Kor empire collapses after a civil war between the city and its Skyclave; the Skyclave falls onto Jwar Isle, fracturing the land into the Trenches.
timeline.quote: The Skyclave fell onto Jwar Isle , fracturing the land into the Trenches seen today.

citation.text: "Makindi", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: It is revealed that the Kor's appearance on Rath and other planes is due to abductions from Zendikar.
timeline.quote: It is revealed that their appearance on Rath and other planes is due to abductions from Zendikar.

citation.text: "Zendikar", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The narrator's intended lair site becomes an elemental and goes off to terrorize some kor.
timeline.quote: the lair site got up

citation.work: The Look of an Awakening World
citation.text: "The Look of an Awakening World". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Feb 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The native peoples of Zendikar, the Kor, merfolk and vampires, try to understand the Eldrazi and how to defeat them.
timeline.quote: The Kor, merfolk, and vampires all tried to understand and figure out what the Eldrazi were and how could they defeat them.

citation.text: "First Week's Flavor". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jun 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The columnist inducts viashino, kor and kithkin as Magic exclusives.
timeline.quote: Inducted all.

citation.text: "Magic's Exclusive Creatures". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Aug 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Nissa joins Hamadi, Bahkut, Alira and the kor twins Khali and Sha'heel, who rope the party for a climb through gravity fields of floating boulders.
timeline.quote: Once everyone was secured, they moved into the gravity fields.

citation.text: "Nissa, Worldwaker" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2014.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis recalls hating Zendikar and its people, and sees Nahiri's face in each of the kor.
timeline.quote: Because in each of their smug, chalky faces, I see her .

citation.text: "Dreams of the Damned" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Aug 2014.

timeline.summary: A kor walks into the cavern and the Eldrazi part to admit him.
timeline.quote: The swirling mass of Eldrazi parted to admit him, then closed in his wake.

citation.text: Kor Castigator (Battle for Zendikar, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gideon learns from the kor the difference between working together and working as one.
timeline.quote: After watching the kor in battle, Gideon understood the difference between working together and working as one.

citation.text: Smite the Monstrous (Battle for Zendikar, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kor sentries find Nahiri and Tenri heals her wounds.
timeline.quote: The tall woman raised her hands, setting them aglow with healing magic.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: The Kargans, riding tamed dragons, shatter the Akoum Skyclave, ending Kor rule in the region.
timeline.quote: Their coordinated attacks ultimately succeeded in bringing down the Skyclave.

citation.text: "Akoum Skyclave", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The kor herders of the Pillar Plains are massacred in 4537 and their bodies hung over Thunder Gap.
timeline.quote: in 4537, they were all massacred

citation.text: "Murasa", section "Notable locations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the civil war the Ondu Skyclave turns against Makindi, destroying it, and falls onto Jwar Isle.
timeline.quote: the Ondu Skyclave turned against the empire's capital at Makindi

citation.text: "Ondu Skyclave", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Kor Empire collapses and each Skyclave falls in a different way, from the Roil, rebellion, a sea beast, civil war, Kargan dragons, Iona, and an Eldrazi titan.
timeline.quote: over a century, the empire fractured and ultimately collapsed

citation.text: "Rise of the Skyclaves", section "The fall of the Skyclaves". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the Echoverse the kor empire never fell and still controls Zendikar from the Skyclaves.
timeline.quote: the kor empire never fell, and they still hold significant control over the plane from the Skyclaves.

citation.text: "Kor", section "Echoverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the Rathi Overlay displaced kor settle the steppe and adopt berserker ways.
timeline.quote: the steppes became home to displaced kor

citation.text: "Balduvian Steppe", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the Echoverse, Omnath eats through its last bindings after a century of imprisonment.
timeline.quote: Omnath ate through the last of its bindings and freely roamed the plane once more

citation.text: "Omnath", section "Echoverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A civil war between Makindi and the Ondu Skyclave destroys Makindi and ruins the Skyclave, which falls onto Jwar Isle.
timeline.quote: a civil war between the city and the Ondu Skyclave caused Makindi’s destruction and the Skyclave’s ruin, which fell onto Jwar Isle

citation.text: "Ondu", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Stoneforge mystics turn the ruins into Stone Havens bound to hedrons to ward off the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: These mystics have turned the exposed ruins into shelters known as Stone Havens

citation.text: "Spikefields", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At Ghostwatch, Mul Daya elves and kor clerics invoke kor revenants and elf ghosts as guardians.
timeline.quote: Together, they have invoked kor revenants and elf ghosts to guard the haven

citation.text: "Spikefields", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
